status: No public measured physical-WL/chip/age/PEC-to-read-retry/latency table suitable for AiF calibration was located in the inspected primary sources.

source.title: Experimental Study on System-Level Performance Impact of Read Disturbance in Modern SSDs
source.publication: POMACS 10(1), article10, March2026 / SIGMETRICS2026; arXiv August14,2026
source.read_depth: Methodology section4 and selected section5.1/5.2 results; official author publication listing checked.

confirmed: 15 NVMe SSDs, controlled temperature/lifetime and FIO direct-I/O read stress. Preconditioning attempts to remove fresh-data SLC effects. Results concern host-LBA weak spots and maintenance impact; physical FTL addresses are not controlled.
artifact_status: No raw measurement log/dataset repository linked in inspected paper or official author listing. This bounded search does not prove none exists.
usable: Reproducible host-level measurement protocol, not a WL-level input profile for an in-flash placement simulator.
other_bounds: QCFlash has measured threshold data for three QLC wordlines, not a latency/retry surface. Official MQSim permits separate page-type times, but its homogeneous defaults are configuration, not measured heterogeneity.
AiF_terminology: be-enc(1,3,3) uses reliable single-sensing LSB weight bits while CSB/MSB remain ordinary data; calling entire blocks pSLC would be inaccurate.
no_claim: No synthetic physical reliability spread, calibrated latency gain or novel generic hot/cold mapping claimed.
